values.AssociatedLNGNotes: The Energy Information Administration pipeline projects list for May 2026 gives the demand served as LNG and storage. Pipeline and Gas Journal said in October 2025 that the site is within 25 miles of more than 30 billion cubic feet a day of current and planned LNG demand.

records.researcher_notes: LNG is one of the stated purposes of the storage hub and its header pipelines. No single terminal is named, so the terminal cell is blank. The EIA May 2026 file already on the sheet also lists LNG/Storage as demand served.

values.AssociatedLNGNotes: A 2019 Federal Energy Regulatory Commission order on the Freeport LNG Train 4 project says gas for the project arrives at the Stratton Ridge meter station from interconnections that include the Brazoria Interconnector Pipeline.

verifications.note: FERC order names Brazoria Interconnector Pipeline as a supply to the Freeport LNG Train 4 meter station.

records.researcher_notes: The tie runs through the Stratton Ridge meter station that feeds Freeport LNG. EIA also lists Freeport LNG Development as the operator of the project.
